summary_md: **NMBR5 ([@NMBR_5_is_Alive](https://x.com/NMBR_5_is_Alive/status/2116723163572867147))** built a **Standing Rules Database** skill with Kiro, Python and SQLite so agents retain key rules and facts beyond context limits ([NMBR5sgit/standing-rules-database-skill](https://github.com/NMBR5sgit/standing-rules-database-skill), [demo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FsZe0ghD_hQ)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - NMBR5sgit/standing-rules-database-skill: A growing standing-rules database for AI agents. Rule storage and context cost are decoupled: the database grows to hundreds of rules, but each job only loads the handful its triggers match.
